1. **F1 — high, blocking, issue-impact:** The new precheck still runs after `Cli::parse()` at [`crates/jit/src/main.rs:1657`](crates/jit/src/main.rs:1657). Clap’s global version handler is enabled at [`crates/jit/src/cli.rs:25`](crates/jit/src/cli.rs:25), so a stale checker child invoked as `jit -V`/`jit --version` exits during parsing before `stale_gate_child_precheck()` at line 1663. Help paths have the same ordering. A checker can therefore consume stale help/version output and return a normal persisted verdict without a stale-binary refusal, violating REQ-02. The added regression covers only `--schema` and the `version` subcommand.
